brand.name: oVoxi
brand.tagline: The Curated Music Catalog for the AI Generation
brand.tone: Authoritative, futuristic, secure, high-end infrastructure, venture-backed

surface_strategies.header: Crystal Glass: bg-slate-950/60 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10
surface_strategies.cards: Flat background (bg-white/[0.02]), 1px subtle border (border-white/10), hover glow effect

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Cards lift -translate-y-1, border changes to border-blue-500/50, subtle blue drop-shadow
motion_and_interactions.animations: Framer Motion for staggered entrance on lists and bento grids. Slow drift for background nodes.
motion_and_interactions.particles: Use tsparticles for background abstract network floating nodes to simulate AI connectivity.

components.buttons: Shadcn Button, customized to have either solid electric blue bg or transparent with 1px border and blue glow.
components.forms: Shadcn Form/Input, dark background, border-white/10, focus:ring-blue-500
components.tables: Shadcn Table, border-collapse, subtle border-b on rows, no zebra striping.

icons_and_assets.testing: All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='hero-cta-button')

hero_background.description: Abstract blue glowing lines on a dark background to signify AI neural networks and data streams.

market_opportunity.description: Mesmerizing glowing neon blue optical fibers.

artists_section.description: Man working on music production in a dimly lit modern studio.

team_ceo.description: Professional man in suit (Tyler Jatzeck-Cooke CEO)

team_head_of_ar.description: Professional man (Jordan JUS Martin Head of Artist Relations)

instructions_to_main_agent: Configure Tailwind config with Outfit and Manrope fonts.
Implement the bento grid (Mode B Control Room hybrid with Mode A for marketing tension) for the 'Why oVoxi' and 'Business Model' sections.
Apply the Tracing Beam or glowing border effects on hover for interactive elements to mimic high-end AI infrastructure like Vercel and ElevenLabs.
Avoid using any consumer streaming platform vibes; this is an infrastructure layer for enterprise buyers and investors.
For the hero section, layer the text over the hero background image with an opacity of 30-50% gradient to black to maintain stark readability.
Build the multi-page structure with React Router.
Ensure the competitive comparison table is strict, clean, high-contrast, matching SaaS pricing tier visuals.
Every interactive element MUST include data-testid attribute for testing.
